meta.title: Update benchmarks and remove interpreter
meta.body_summary: Re-run benchmarks, drop interpreter from benchmark runs, and rename sum to sum_loop in benchmark template to avoid builtin conflict.

perf_labels.notes: Chore PR updating benchmark artifacts and removing interpreter; self-merged by maintainer within ~1.5 minutes with no review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 271 changed lines across 36 files, this is a small chore update by absolute volume, mostly modifying benchmark output files. It fits a low-risk maintenance PR that merged instantly without review, consistent with maintainer self-merge.

review_details.performance_claim: Dropping interpreter from benchmark runs to produce more representative VM performance measurements.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Updating benchmark results and removing interpreter from benchmark runs requires executing `make bench` and committing generated files, a task within agent capabilities.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Testing instructions (`make bench`) are provided, but no numeric performance claims or before/after comparisons are given in the PR body.

core_change_summary.description: Updated BENCHMARK.md and 35 benchmark output files under bench/out/ with re-run timing results, modified bench/runner.go to remove interpreter execution, and renamed sum to sum_loop in sum_loop.mochi template to avoid Python builtin conflict.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The bulk of changes are in benchmark output files reflecting re-run results; the core modifications are in runner.go and the template rename.
change_trajectory: Single commit re-running benchmarks, updating all output files, removing interpreter from runner, and renaming sum to sum_loop.
